title: Core Septet #46
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, seven women in a single row.

A photograph of SEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 7 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left to right:
[Egyptian Glam / Super Glamour]: Egyptian woman, mid 30s, cheerful, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, sleek straight hair, coffin nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back. Shoes: extreme gold platform stiletto peep-toe heels.

[Lebanese Wedding Glam / Legend Bust]: Lebanese woman, mid 50s, cheerful, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, high ponytail hair, square nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Czech Bohemian crystal-engraving motif (a deep black ground with fine engraved silver linework), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward. Shoes: extreme silver plain stiletto pumps.

[manba / Black Glamour]: Japanese woman, early 40s, cheerful, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long bleached platinum hair with a neon streak, a fierce, playful expression, low bun hair, coffin nails (chrome). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back. Shoes: extreme silver platform stiletto heels.

[glamorous party / Black Glamour]: Korean woman, mid 40s, bold and confident, fair ivory skin, smoky eyes in champagne-gold glitter shadow, a sharp winged liner, full lashes, softly contoured cheekbones with a glowing highlight, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy gradient lips in deep rose, long sleek black waves, a confident, luminous expression, high ponytail hair, almond nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme gold-leaf platform stiletto Mary Janes.

[Egyptian Glam / Powerlifter]: Egyptian woman, mid 40s, demure and soft, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, wavy hair, coffin nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Shoes: extreme gold thigh-high stiletto boots.

[Egyptian Glam / Brazilian Booty]: Egyptian woman, early 20s, cool and composed, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, braided hair, coffin nails (holographic). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: both hands framing her own face. Shoes: extreme cream extreme platform clear heels.

[1960s Italian film-star / Curved Bust]: Italian woman, mid 20s, bold and confident, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, thick glossy dark-brown hair set in a high backcombed style, a smouldering, confident expression, low bun hair, square nails (matte). An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme mother-of-pearl platform stiletto slingbacks.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 7, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
